title: noyalib-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for lossless YAML 1.2 editing by AI agents. Two tools over stdio (JSON-RPC 2.0): noyalib_get (read the value at a dotted/indexed path, returning the source slice exactly) and noyalib_set (write a value at a path, rewriting only the touched span so comments, blank lines, and sibling entries are preserved byte-for-byte, written atomically). Built on noyalib's lossless concrete syntax tree.
